summary: Listed in the Forest Lookouts index for Jackson County; no source found gives its build date, design or current status.

evidence.supports: Index lists the Bascom lookout in Jackson County
Index gives the lookout location as T6N R9W

corrections.why: T6N R9W is a Public Land Survey township and range, a legal land location, not a managing agency. The index names no agency.

notes_for_editor: No story written: the only source naming this tower is the index entry (name, county, T6N R9W). That cannot reach the 120-word floor without padding. Checked and empty: Wikipedia Bascom, Florida (no tower or lookout mention); the cached Florida lists on firetower.org and nhlr.org (no Bascom); firelookout.org Florida page ('Data being compiled'); a 2015 Florida chapter report (no Bascom). Two web searches found no Bascom lookout record or photo. The record's coordinates come from the eastern_us_lookouts source and are not verified. Needs a Florida Forest Service, Florida Master Site File or county historical record before a story is possible.
